name: Admin API to query delegated tenant settings
description: This API enables tenant administrators to track settings modifications made by other administrators at capacity, domain, or workspace levels. It scans and returns all the units of governance or a group of such units where the tenant admin settings have been overridden. In the initial release, we aim to include the ability to query tenant settings delegated to a capacity.

result.nameEs: API de administración para consultar la configuración delegada del tenant
